Leonard hauled him the rest of the way up by the collar. He did it roughly, without tenderness, and Mary saw that his jaw was set hard.

"Is he breathing?" she asked.

"He's breathing." Leonard stripped off his own coat and threw it over the shaking figure. "More's the pity, maybe."

"Don't," she said.
